opening.argument: The title explicitly calls OneCoin a scam, and the concluding slide reads “THE BLACKLIST.” Those choices frame the pricing material as critical examination, not an endorsement. The presentation does discuss a claimed relationship between mining difficulty and coin price, and its slides display alleged profit and luxury purchases. But showing those claims is not the same as asking viewers to act on them: there is no request for money, personal data, enrollment, or any other viewer action. Taken together, the explicit scam framing and the absence of a solicitation support reading this as reporting or criticism, without establishing any viewer loss or outcome.
